messages:
incident-bot: ⚠️ INCIDENT detected: Elevated streaming p99 latency for customer marigold (single-tenant). Metric spike started ~3476543150. SLO p99 breached. Paging oncall.

amy (oncall): I'm on it. seeing alerts in the console too — p95 ~420ms -> 980ms, p99 ~1.8s -> 4.2s for streaming endpoints. Confirming impact: streaming token stalls, some sessions stuck mid-stream.

marigold-support: We're seeing customers report partial responses and timeouts in our client. This started after a big batch job this morning (~120 req/s sustained). We sent a sample prompt set to SE.

samir (infra): grabbing pod metrics. Noted queue depth climb on dedicated pool marigold-dedicated-01; CPU plateaued, GPU util ~75% but per-worker token loop stalled. Could be KV cache thrash or long-prefix blocking batching.

lucy (runtime): Streaming stalls often show up when very long prompt prefixes cause KV snapshot churn. Can you paste an example prompt or avg seq len?

marigold-support: avg token len ~1400, some outliers >6k (they're passing large context windows for fine-grained analysis). Also lots of concurrent small chat requests mixed in — high QPS + very long prefix.

amy (oncall): OK that explains tail. Immediate mitigation options: 1) enable per-customer request-size throttling, 2) route new sessions to a lower-cost async path, 3) spin up extra dedicated workers (fast), 4) enable model fallback to a quantized variant with better long-prefix behavior. Which to attempt first?

ops-triage: Recommend spin-up + fallback. Start scale and toggle fallback gradually to avoid regressions.

samir (infra): Scaling action: `kubectl scale --replicas=6 deploy/marigold-runtime --namespace=dedicated-marigold` -> executed. Watch pods coming up.

incident-bot: Deploy event: marigold-runtime pods scaling to 6 triggered by samir at 3476543320.

lucy (runtime): While pods warm up, enable fallback routing at the load-balancer level: add header-based route to `model-xq-quant` for marigold new sessions. Patch snippet:

```
# apply route: marigold -> model-xq-quant for new
PATCH /routing/customers/marigold
{ "route_policy": "prefer_quant_fallback", "fraction": 0.5 }
```

amy (oncall): Applying canary 50% new sessions -> `model-xq-quant`. If we see quality regressions we'll drop to 20% then 0.

samir (infra): Pods are Ready. New workers joined pool at 3476543380. Queue depth reduced from 120 -> 45 within 30s.

marigold-support: We're still seeing a stream stall case at session id `sess_7f3a`. Will paste stack traces if helpful.

lucy (runtime): Please paste logs for that session. Also, check for repeated prefix tokens causing KV cache eviction thrash: `grep sess_7f3a /var/log/runtime/*.log | tail -n 200`

marigold-support: pasted log: "[stream] sent 1200 tokens, kv_evictions=7, stall_detected=true, stall_cause=kv-reload"

amy (oncall): That aligns with KV eviction churn. Longer-term: we need a per-tenant KV prepin policy and better caching heuristics. For now, two short-term steps: 1) enable aggressive KV pin for marigold's shard (prevent frequent evictions), 2) advise customer to batch very long contexts via our upload API (offload to blob store).

samir (infra): Applied KV pin flag: `redwood-admin kv pin --tenant marigold --ttl 10m` -> acknowledged by runtime at 3476543502.

incident-bot: KV pin applied for tenant marigold at 3476543502. Expect reduced eviction churn.

lucy (runtime): Observed immediate drop in `kv_evictions` metric for affected workers from 7 -> 0 within ~20s for sessions hitting pin. p99 latency started to decline to ~2.1s. Good sign.

amy (oncall): Continue monitoring for 15m. Customer impacted sessions should be routed to new pods / fallback. If p99 < 1.5s for 5m, we'll start de-escalation.

marigold-support: Noting we have a scheduled large analytics job at 04:00 UTC that may re-trigger this pattern. Can you advise safe QPS limits for long-context jobs?

ops-triage: Recommend limit long-context worker QPS to 20 r/s per shard or queue via rate-limit header. Also provide a small doc and a sample multipart upload flow to batch huge contexts.

kevin (oncall-next): I'm on standby for the handoff at 3476543745. If p99 stabilizes, I'll take over monitoring and run follow-up action items (improve pin TTL, add rate-limiter rule, assist customer integration).

amy (oncall): Handoff plan: I'll keep the channel open for 10m, then mark status as "monitoring" and hand off to kevin. Action items for kevin: 1) postmortem, 2) follow up with product on per-tenant KV policy, 3) work with marigold on upload API adoption.

incident-bot: Incident status -> MONITORING. p99 reduced from 4.2s -> 1.9s after mitigations. Paging cleared for oncall rotation.

amy (oncall): Thanks team — nice coordinated mitigation. Leaving channel in 8m, kevin will take over. :thumbsup:

kevin (oncall-next): Acknowledged. I'll start the postmortem draft after I verify metrics hold for next 30m.

marigold-support: Thanks everyone, appreciate the fast help. We'll throttle our analytics job until we integrate upload API.
